title: Hausdorff dimension of non-uniquely ergodic directions in eigenform loci
summary: We consider the eigenform locus $\mathcal{E}_D$ in $\mathcal{H}(1,1)$ where $D$ is not a square. We prove that for any translation surface $(X,ω) \in \mathcal{E}_D$, the set of non-uniquely ergodic directions has Hausdorff dimension $1/2$, except when $D=5$ and $(X,ω)$ lies in the Teichmüller curve generated by the regular decagon.
